cards.statement: Text: The bus app helps residents plan journeys around delays. Statement: The app sells bus tickets.
cards.explanation: El texto dice que no vende tickets.

cards.statement: Text: Mina cycles three days a week. Statement: Mina cycles every day.
cards.explanation: Three days a week no significa every day.

cards.statement: Text: The repair café cannot accept large appliances. Statement: Large appliances are accepted.
cards.explanation: Cannot accept excluye esos aparatos.

cards.statement: Text: The community cinema shows old films on Fridays. Statement: It shows them on Fridays.
cards.explanation: La afirmación repite el detalle temporal.

cards.statement: Text: The school garden supports science lessons. Statement: The garden has no educational use.
cards.explanation: Science lessons son un uso educativo explícito.

cards.explanation: Bring one question each es explícito.

cards.statement: Text: Nadia moved her desk because the room was too dark. Statement: Darkness was the reason.
cards.explanation: Because the room was too dark expresa la causa.

cards.statement: Text: Customers get their cup deposit back when they return it. Statement: The deposit is returned.
cards.explanation: Get it back significa recibir de nuevo el depósito.

cards.statement: Text: Residents planted trees to improve the riverside path. Statement: The work aims to improve the path.
cards.explanation: Improve the path aparece como objetivo.

cards.statement: Text: Leo's group meets on Wednesday evenings. Statement: The group meets on Sunday mornings.
cards.explanation: El día y momento contradicen la afirmación.

cards.statement: Text: The festival expected 200 visitors but nearly 350 arrived. Statement: Fewer people arrived than expected.
cards.explanation: Nearly 350 es una cantidad superior a 200.

cards.statement: Text: Study-room slots give more students a chance to use the desks. Statement: The slots are intended to share a popular space.
cards.explanation: La finalidad se expresa en give more students a chance.

cards.statement: Text: The tool library helps members avoid buying equipment they rarely use. Statement: Members must buy every tool.

cards.statement: Text: The market opens every Saturday. Statement: The market is weekly.
cards.explanation: Every Saturday equivale a una frecuencia semanal.

cards.statement: Text: Drainage work should reduce puddles but not stop all flooding. Statement: The work guarantees no flooding.
cards.explanation: Not stop all flooding limita la conclusión.

cards.statement: Text: Evening language classes are affordable and near the station. Statement: The classes are described as expensive.
cards.explanation: Affordable contradice expensive.

cards.statement: Text: A yoga class at 7 a.m. is for people who work late. Statement: It is designed only for professional athletes.

cards.statement: Text: A volunteer bus helps older residents without cars reach the hospital. Statement: It is mainly a tourist service.

cards.statement: Text: The cycling route is two kilometres longer but quieter. Statement: The new route is shorter and busier.

cards.statement: Text: Museum headphones are available at the entrance without extra charge. Statement: Visitors must pay extra for headphones.
